name: luz-de-mae
description: Luz de Mãe: caderneta da gestante digital com alertas para a UBS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @luz-de-mae/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:prod -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w @luz-de-mae/shared && npm test -w api && npm run test:e2e -w api && npm test -w luz-de-mae-backend
